blocks.text: {Firm name} (“firm,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is pleased to provide {Client name} (“you” or “your”) with the payroll services described below for {Agreement year}. Please read this letter, the Terms and Conditions below and any other attachments incorporated herein (collectively, “Agreement”).
From the hours, rates, pay changes and other payroll information you approve and send us each pay period, we will:

items: calculate gross pay, withholdings and deductions and prepare each pay period’s payroll in the payroll software we use;

prepare the federal and state payroll tax returns due during the year (such as Forms 941 and 940 and state withholding and unemployment returns) for your review and signature or, where you authorize us in writing, for filing on your behalf;
prepare Forms W-2 and W-3 after year end; and
prepare payroll reports for your records.

blocks.text: Our services do not include determining whether a worker is an employee or an independent contractor, benefits administration, retirement plan testing or filings, workers’ compensation audits, or responding to tax authority notices, unless we agree to them in writing.

You remain responsible for paying your employees and for depositing payroll taxes on time, including where a payroll service provider draws them from your account. You must keep enough funds available on each draw date. Payroll tax penalties and interest that result from late or incomplete information, insufficient funds, or deposits you make are your responsibility.

You are responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the payroll information you approve, for new-hire paperwork and reporting (including Forms I-9 and W-4), for telling us promptly of new employees, terminations, pay changes and new work locations, and for keeping your own payroll records. You will designate a person with suitable skill, knowledge and experience to approve each payroll and oversee our services.
Our fees for the services in this Agreement are:

A monthly fee is charged each month to the payment method you set up on our client portal, until this Agreement ends. Off-cycle payrolls, amended returns and corrections caused by information received late are billed separately at our standard rates after we tell you of them.

This Agreement covers the services for {Agreement year} and continues month to month after that until replaced by a new agreement or ended by either party in writing, as the Terms and Conditions describe. If it ends during the year, we will prepare the payroll tax returns for the quarters we processed in full.

We appreciate the opportunity to be of service to you. This Agreement, including the Terms and Conditions, represents the entire agreement of the parties relating to the services that are the subject of this Agreement. Please sign below to accept it.
